title: Directive (EU) 2020/739, Article 2 amending Directive (EU) 2019/1833 Article 2(1)

result: The general deadline remains 20 November 2021. An earlier 24 November 2020 deadline applies to changes to Annexes V and VI insofar as they relate to SARS-CoV-2.
temporal_limit: Both operative dates predate the September 2026 response. This does not establish German compliance or authenticate the addressed August draft.
